nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) wallets holding the balance keyed by an address/public key.
Public address owner; set once in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
Constructor(address _owner) that assigns the initial owner of the contract.
External payable put(address _pub) that credits msg.value to wallets[_pub].
External view peek(address _pub) that returns wallets[_pub].
External get(bytes32,bytes32,uint8) that recovers a signer from an ecdsa signature over msg.sender and transfers wallets[signer] to msg.sender.
Owner-only rem(address _pub) that transfers the whole wallets[_pub] balance to owner and zeroes it.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as the signed message, transfer recipient, and access-control subject.
Parameter _owner of the constructor, used to initialize the owner state variable.
Parameter _pub of put, used as the key index into the wallets mapping.
Parameter _pub of peek, used as the key index into the wallets mapping.
Parameter _r (32 bytes) of get, the ecdsa signature r component.
Parameter _s (32 bytes) of get, the ecdsa signature s component.
Parameter _v (uint8) of get, constrained to 27 or 28 before being used in ecrecover.
Parameter _pub of rem, used as the key index into the wallets mapping.
Local variable signer holding the address recovered by ecrecover inside get.
ecrecover call in get: returns address(0) on failure and derives the wallet key from a caller-supplied signature.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(wallets[signer]) in get: external value transfer performed before the balance is zeroed.
payable(owner).transfer(wallets[_pub]) in rem: external value transfer to owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used inside get as the message that is hashed and signed by the wallet key.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner address to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer performed by get.
The constructor writes _owner into the owner state variable.
The constructor parameter _owner supplies the value assigned to owner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for its access check.
The onlyOwner modifier gates the execution of rem.
put increments the wallets mapping entry for the supplied key with msg.value.
The _pub parameter of put indexes the wallets mapping being credited.
The _pub parameter of peek indexes the wallets mapping being read.
peek reads its return value directly from the wallets state variable.
The _pub parameter of rem indexes the wallets mapping that is drained.
get reads wallets[signer] to validate it is non-zero before the withdrawal.
The recovered signer local variable determines whose balance is transferred out by get.
The withdrawn amount in get comes from the wallets mapping read after signature verification.
get executes the external value transfer before resetting wallets[signer] to zero.
get zeroes wallets[signer] after the external transfer, an ordering that is exploitable by reentrancy.
The external transfer to msg.sender can call back into get before the balance is cleared.
rem clears wallets[_pub] after performing the owner transfer.
rem performs an external value transfer to the owner before zeroing the balance.
The owner state variable is the recipient of the external transfer in rem.
The transferred amount in rem is the wallets[_pub] balance read from state.
The external transfer in rem can call back into the contract while the balance is still recorded.
The _r parameter is passed to ecrecover as the signature r component.
The _s parameter is passed to ecrecover as the signature s component.
The _v parameter is validated against 27/28 and passed to ecrecover.
ecrecover returns the signer address, which is stored in the signer local variable.
get invokes ecrecover to derive the wallet key from the supplied signature.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _owner is only used to initialize the owner state variable inside the constructor.
The _pub parameter of put is only used as the mapping key written by put.
The _pub parameter of peek is only used as the mapping key read by peek.
_r is consumed directly by the ecrecover call as the signature r component.
_s is consumed directly by the ecrecover call as the signature s component.
_v is validated and then consumed directly by the ecrecover call as the recovery id.
The _pub parameter of rem is only used as the mapping key drained by rem.
The signer local variable is produced by ecrecover and immediately determines the recipient balance transferred by the external call.
